outcome: Pelvic floor muscle function (vaginal resting pressure, vaginal squeezing pressure, vaginal contraction duration)
cohort: 479 puerperae were recruited within 1 week postpartum for the cross-sectional study, and 240 vaginal delivery puerperae were enrolled within 1 week postpartum for the randomized controlled trial.
finding: The incidence of postpartum SUI was 25.7%, with vaginal delivery, elevated age, and BMI identified as independent risk factors, and the comprehensive care and rehabilitation program (CCRP) significantly strengthened pelvic floor muscle functions and decreased postpartum SUI incidence.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was identified as an independent risk factor for postpartum SUI.
cross-section timing: Recruitment within 1 week postpartum, SUI incidence and risk factors evaluated at 8th week postpartum.
birth_weight: Measured as a risk factor; specific weight range for inclusion not mentioned.
